notablePrerequisites: You have at least four other cards in hand.
description:
Cast Inner Fire by paying {3}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Inner Fire.
Resolve the copy of Inner Fire, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
